upstream_features: 0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol: listed with a Codex sign-in, thinking up to Max, a 1.05M context window on an API key, and Ultrafast on Sol.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added balance and plan usage for Zhipu (BigModel / Z.ai), StepFun, MiniMax Coding Plan, OpenCode Go, ModelScope, Ollama Cloud and AiHubMix.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added "Items to Show" to the balance widget's settings, to pick which items it displays.

0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added "Move to..." for the input: its text, attachments and pasted blocks go to another chat, with Append / Replace / Cancel when that chat has a draft, and a 5 second Undo.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a choice of how the chat list is searched, on a long press of the search button: Quick Filter (titles and last messages) or Full Text Search (every message).
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added picking single chats inside a folder in select mode: the folder's arrow opens it, its circle selects the whole folder, and its card counts what is selected.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a pill at the top of a chat for running sub agents, and a sub agent's progress reports now fold to the newest.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added folding of tool calls as a task goes: the running step keeps its latest three, and a finished step folds at once.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a "Workspace layout" tip on the first new chat: which folders a chat has to itself, which all chats share, and a button into the chat's files.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added `android-a11y-cli gesture drag` and timed gesture paths: a long press followed by a drag in one touch, for moving icons and list rows.
0-beta-build45: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added paging information to the list commands for contacts, calendar, photos and notifications: how many rows there are and how to read on.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a cold start from the launcher's Camera shortcut opening the camera again and again; a shortcut now opens one chat and runs its action once.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed Ultrafast being offered for models the Codex catalogue lists without it; a refused Ultrafast request is now sent once more as Fast.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed an OpenAI-compatible server added with a token and a base URL getting the built-in GPT models; refreshing now asks the server itself.

0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed restoring a backup: every skill of the package is added with its name and state, the ones that could not be added are named, MCP servers are merged, and sub agents restore without a readable provider file.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a sub agent whose reply was cut off at the output limit; it now reports that and hands over what it wrote.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a new chat's Files page, folder links, terminal and pictures using a temporary chat id; file links now work on a sub agent's transcript.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the Files page's pull-to-refresh indicator staying on the list.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the tool bar's step counter wrapping to two lines; it now stays on one line and shrinks from four digits.
0-beta-build45: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the last row of a chat overlapping the tool preview thumbnail on the first frame.
0-beta-build45: [كۆرۈنۈش] A prompt inserted while a reply runs is now shown where it was delivered, with the reply right under it.
0-beta-build45: [كۆرۈنۈش] "Show full thinking" is now the whole hint line and easier to tap.
0-beta-build45: [كۆرۈنۈش] The round glass buttons on the home page and in the chat now have a faint outline in the light theme.
0-beta-build45: [كۆرۈنۈش] The sub agent pill now shows summary numbers only, so its width stays steady.
0-beta-build45: [كۆرۈنۈش] The long-press card on your profile picture, and the assistant's name opening Settings > Soul.

0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added home-screen widgets: "Chats" (recent, unfinished or pinned chats, or one group's chats, each row opening its chat), "Quick Actions", and "Usage & Balance" (token usage for today / 7 days / 30 days, or a provider's balance).
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added your own profile in Settings > Soul: display name, what the assistant calls you, and a picture.
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added DeepSeek speech for read-aloud and voice input, using the DeepSeek provider's own key.
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added five session icons (bug, review, devops, device, agent); an icon you picked by hand is now kept.
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added folding for the Pinned section on the home list.
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added tap-to-enlarge for images in the tool detail sheet.
0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added two composer drags: down on the focused composer puts the keyboard away, and a drag on the voice panel collapses or expands it.

0-beta-build44: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added anonymous usage statistics for official builds, with a notice on first launch. It sends launch counts, approximate usage time, rough chat activity and crash counts - never conversations, files, keys or your IP address. You can view what is sent, turn it off, reset the identifier or delete your data in Settings > Privacy.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a crash of the agent foreground service at the end of a turn, on cancel, or when leaving a chat.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed links from a widget row or a notification opening a new chat when the app's process was gone.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed formulas while streaming: a `$$` or `\[ … \]` formula now shows as a formula from its first row, also right after a sentence.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a line that only starts with a number being drawn as a list item.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed GitHub Copilot models that are served through the Responses API, and the order of tool outputs in Responses requests.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed browser tools: a navigation with no response is stopped after 30 s, full-page screenshots stay within a safe size, and set_viewport resizes one tab at a time.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the interactive terminal's second start attempt, and a terminal closed while it boots.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the thinking picker offering a level that Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon do not have.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the status of a cancelled sub agent: it now shows its progress and how to resume it.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the "Switched model" notice being lost on a retry, and a tool call being stored twice after a fallback.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the session edit sheet's "Recent" icons not showing.
0-beta-build44: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a database left at a removed version failing to open.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] The settings pages' top bar and the Markdown preview's top bar are now glass, with content scrolling behind them.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] Glass surfaces are denser, so text scrolling under them stays readable.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] Redesigned the minis-config approval dialog: one card per change, with name, path, old and new value on their own lines.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] Rootfs Management, the "… in Session" sheets and Token Usage now use the standard card layout.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] The "Recent" header on the home list now carries a clock icon.
0-beta-build44: [كۆرۈنۈش] Refined the composer's edge, the voice input halo and the read-aloud button in the light theme.
0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added Claude Fable 5.2 to the Claude model list. Claude subscription sign-ins now present as a newer Claude Code client, which Fable 5.2 requires.

0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a real Full Screen to the browser: the page covers the whole screen, and Back, the exit button or the handle at the top (tap it or pull it down) take you out. Tabs and scroll position stay as they were.

0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Takeover now sits beside the browser's address field. While you are in control, the agent waits until you tap Hand Back (at most 5 minutes), and its next result notes that the page may have changed.
0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] A pull down at the top of a previewed web page now closes the preview sheet; every other drag still scrolls the page.

0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Auto-grouping is now one global switch, shown as the first row of the Groups list in Move to Group and kept in step with Settings and minis-config. When it is on, a new chat can be filed into any of your groups.

0-beta-build43: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added import and export to Environment Variables. Import from pasted text or a file (.env or JSON) and review every variable in a preview before it is saved. Export as a template without values, Base64 or plain text, to a file or the clipboard; the two modes that include values ask you to confirm first.
0-beta-build43: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a chat waiting on its own scheduled follow-up not showing the running spinner in the home list; it now shows it for the whole wait.
0-beta-build43: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a browser tab the agent uses in the background playing media: it now starts no video or sound and opens no full-screen player until you look at it.
0-beta-build43: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed many screens showing English in other languages: every missing translation in all 23 languages is now filled in.
0-beta-build43: [كۆرۈنۈش] The time on a reply's usage line now always includes the month and day, such as "Nov 8 17:15".
0-beta-build43: [كۆرۈنۈش] The notice card shown after a reply switched models is now more compact.
0-beta-build43: [كۆرۈنۈش] The bottom edge of the chat top bar has a stronger tint, so text scrolling under it stays out of the way.
0-beta-build43: [كۆرۈنۈش] The scheduled countdown pill now floats over the messages without taking room in the list.

0-beta-build42: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] The top of the home list is now a Recent section, for the time being. It shows unread chats, chats that are running, and chats you used in the last hour. A chat you have read stays there, dimmed, until an hour after its last activity. The header still counts the unread ones, and the setting is under Settings > Appearance.

0-beta-build42: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a Control Server setting for the built-in Tailscale node (Settings > Network > Tailscale), so you can join a self-hosted Headscale tailnet. Leave it empty to use Tailscale's own server. Changing it signs this device out of Tailscale; log in again with the browser or a pre-auth key from that server (`headscale preauthkeys create`).
0-beta-build42: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] A scheduled task's message now carries the date and time when it runs, as your own messages do.
0-beta-build42: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] The Soul personality prompt can now be up to 3000 tokens, counted the same way on Android, iOS and Windows.

0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the status bar icons turning white on a light page when the phone is in dark mode and Minis is set to Light, including while a bottom sheet such as Choose Model is open.
0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a half-finished download making the Shell Container look tens of GB larger than it is.
0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the first Search in Chat result landing under the top bar.
0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed English text on the Clear Session Files screen in other languages.
0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the voice input waveform filling all its bars even for a soft voice; it now follows how loud you speak.

0-beta-build42: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the built-in manual being changed from the shell; it is now read-only there. Also fixed a PATH that contained literal quote characters, which made commands like ls "not found" in the terminal, and corrected the backup restore note in every language.
0-beta-build42: [كۆرۈنۈش] Long-pressing or right-clicking chat text now opens a vertical menu with icons, placed below or above the selection where it fits, in the glass style.
0-beta-build42: [كۆرۈنۈش] The glass input box and tool bar have a thin edge highlight and a soft shadow, and the input box is more opaque, so the buttons stay clear over text scrolling under it.
0-beta-build42: [كۆرۈنۈش] The chat title has more room before it is cut off.
0-beta-build42: [كۆرۈنۈش] Improved the speed of the chat list's previews for very long replies.

0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added Arabic. Settings screens use a right-to-left layout in Arabic and Persian, and Arabic or Persian text in a chat (replies, your messages, thinking and the composer) reads right to left, while the chat screen itself keeps its layout.

0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and GPT Image 2.6 Flare for OpenAI signed in with a ChatGPT account. Add them under Settings > Model Groups > Models Minis Can Call at Runtime, and the assistant can generate images with them.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added Fish Audio as a voice provider. You can paste a Fish voice ID as a custom voice.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added read-aloud with a voice you cloned at the vendor: paste its ID as a custom voice.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Added a Speak Responses switch to the chat menu, as on iOS.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Restoring a backup can now keep both copies of a chat, merge them or skip, chat by chat, and can replace the values of named environment variables.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Auto-grouping now files chats only into groups that opt in, shows what each group holds, and marks the chats it filed.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] The Minis manual now ships with the app, and the assistant can read it to answer questions about Minis.
0-beta-build41: [يېڭى ئىقتىدار] Settings > Permissions now has a Device Control section that gathers the accessibility settings, and Privacy is now "Privacy & Data".

0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed image generation with a ChatGPT account: gpt-image-2 and 2.5 failing with "Complexity 'low' is not supported", and requests failing on accounts that cannot use gpt-5.5.

0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed backup restore removing this device's messages and compaction markers when the backup holds a newer copy of a chat, replacing local messages that are as new as the backup's, and mixing up messages sent in the same second.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a duplicated chat sharing its folder and media with the original.

0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed read-aloud skipping replies in later turns and in text mode, a second bubble cutting off the first, and a chat opened during reading talking over it. Tool cues are now read once the call is ready, in the UI language.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a stream that sends headers and then nothing hanging forever; it now ends after the idle timeout.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a 400 on every Responses request when a tool call is repeated in the history.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed tool calls failing when the model sends argument markup instead of JSON; the model is now told how to resend them.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the slide jumping or stopping half way when opening a chat from the list, and the Soul name and "No model selected" showing before the title.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed tapping the floating capsule: it now opens the chat whose task it shows.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed long-pressing New Chat: it opens the model group picker again.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed Doubao recognition with keys from the old console, and iFlytek dictation signatures; both now explain their error codes.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed a Bailian workspace domain (*.maas.aliyuncs.com) not using the Bailian voice provider.
0-beta-build41: [تۈزىتىش] Fixed the auto-group switch being changed from a group's menu; it is now set only when the group is created.
0-beta-build41: [كۆرۈنۈش] Every run of two or more finished tools now folds after the turn.
0-beta-build41: [كۆرۈنۈش] The typing line now says "Connected, waiting for the first token".
0-beta-build41: [كۆرۈنۈش] Improved the speed of Markdown rendering in long replies.
